description: Charred black plates forked open by live orange veins that never cool. What you strike goes on burning after you stop.
lore: Ask somebody who carries one what they carry it in and you get a considered answer. Cloth chars through in a season; a pouch comes back stiff as a boot dried too near the hearth. Most end at a tin of sand lashed outside the pack, where the thing that cannot be persuaded to stop can do the least.

That is also what it does off an edge. Most fire is over when the swing is; this one is left behind, still burning after you step back. What got pressed to make it was never flame — it was the banking: heat held in, year after year, no fuel, no audience, no occasion. A thing like that does not learn to finish just because you have.

Few ever come to hand, since a crossing has to empty first, and the one [[monsters/stone_turtle|Magmashell]] anyone can still visit shows no sign of obliging. A collector once offered [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] good gold to stop paying its pause — one regular fewer, one crossing nearer done. Gunnar quoted back the number of years he has walked it, and the collector could not tell whether that was a price or a warning. Neither has anyone since.
gm_notes: The collector's offer is the market side of Gunnar's quiet preservation of the crossing (see stone_turtle's gm_notes): somebody is waiting for the last regular to give up. Usable as a live tension; never resolve who the collector works for.
